title: Use Midjourney to generate the still frames, then use Seedance 2.5 to add…
content: Use Midjourney to generate the still frames, then use Seedance 2.5 to add motion/animation to those frames for a noir title-sequence style result.
tips: Use Midjourney to generate the still frames, then use Seedance 2.5 to add motion/animation to those frames for a noir title-sequence style result.
